# OpenShift 5 field notes

> Field notes for installing and running OpenShift 5. Read the linked note before answering. A product page, the OpenShift mirror, a lab record, and the OpenShift 4 scripts stay separate. A procedure is a guide you can follow to build that cluster. The commands and the config files are in the note. [OpenShift on AWS](aws/README.md) is the model. When a note still runs a command the 5.0 page marks deprecated, or a tool that page does not document, take it out of the procedure.

[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) says how to answer a user and how to add a note. [README.md](README.md) is the human index. [todo.md](todo.md) lists missing notes, upgrades to re-check, and features disabled on 5.0.0-rc.7.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to answer a user from a note, and how to add one
- [README](README.md): human index of the notes
- [To do](todo.md): missing notes, re-checks, and features disabled on 5.0.0-rc.7
- [Update field notes](.cursor/skills/update-field-notes/SKILL.md): procedure for correcting a note from product docs or the mirror

## Install

- [OpenShift on AWS](aws/README.md): procedure; bastion, AWS CLI, client, and `create cluster` in this repo
- [AWS CLI script](aws/configure-aws-cli.sh): procedure; installs AWS CLI v2 and writes the default profile
- [AWS installer script](aws/configure-openshift-installer.sh): procedure; runs `openshift-install` against `$HOME/cluster`
- [OpenShift on bare metal](bare-metal/README.md): procedure; Agent-based Installer or Assisted Installer for most clusters; user-provisioned PXE and HAProxy when you supply them
- [OpenShift on KVM](kvm-scripts/README.md): pointer to the bare-metal path; guest scripts stay in the OpenShift 4 notes
- [OpenShift on VMware](vmware/README.md): pointer; the step-by-step guides stay in the OpenShift 4 notes
- [Assisted Installer](assisted-installer/README.md): procedure outline; the scripts stay in the OpenShift 4 notes and target 4.y
- [Agent-based Installer](agent-based/README.md): procedure; bare-metal `install-config.yaml` and `agent-config.yaml`, then `agent create image`
- [ROSA](rosa/README.md): procedure; managed service on AWS, separate from the self-managed installer
- [ARO](aro/README.md): pointer; the full command list stays in the OpenShift 4 notes

## Before the nodes boot

- [Client packages](pre-steps/README.md): procedure; `oc` and `openshift-install` from a numbered `openshift-v5` directory
- [Package script](pre-steps/configure-openshift-packages.sh): procedure; installs the 5.x client and installer
- [Other clients](pre-steps/configure-other-clients.sh): procedure; installs Helm, rosa, butane, coreos-installer, and mirror-registry from their own numbered directories
- [Installer binary](configure-installers/README.md): procedure; download `openshift-install` for the release you are installing
- [Ignition](configure-ignitionfiles/README.md): procedure; generate Ignition after the 5.0 installer is on the path
- [DHCP](dhcp-configuration/README.md): procedure; addresses and the PXE handoff on the helper
- [DNS](dns-server-configuration/README.md): procedure; `api`, `api-int`, `*.apps`, and A/PTR records for bootstrap and each node
- [HAProxy](haproxy-configuration/README.md): procedure; API, machine config server, and ingress
- [PXE](pxe-configuration/README.md): procedure; TFTP boot for a user-provisioned machine
- [Web server](webserver-configuration/README.md): procedure; HTTP server for Ignition and the RHCOS live images on a user-provisioned install
- [Helper node](helper-node/README.md): procedure; the host that runs DNS, DHCP, PXE, HAProxy, and HTTP
- [Disconnected mirroring](disconnected-scripts/README.md): procedure; mirror registry, local `mirror-ocp-full.sh` for oc-mirror v2, then `imageContentSources` in `install-config.yaml`
- [Operator catalogs](disconnected-scripts/operator-lifecycle-manager-on-restricted-networks.md): procedure; v5.0 file-based catalog for a disconnected cluster

## After the cluster is up

- [Day-two operations](post-steps/README.md): procedures for the registry, certificates, chrony, cluster resource override, NFS, Quay 3.18, and GitOps
- [Identity providers](post-steps/identity-providers.md): procedure; HTPasswd and OpenID on the `OAuth` object
- [Registry](post-steps/README.md#internal-registry-on-openshift-data-foundation): procedure; internal registry on an OpenShift Data Foundation bucket
- [Certificates](post-steps/README.md#certificates): pointer; the acme.sh script stays in the OpenShift 4 notes
- [Chrony](post-steps/README.md#chrony): procedure; a MachineConfig for chrony, with the Butane version to re-check
- [Cluster resource override](post-steps/README.md#cluster-resource-override): procedure; one `ClusterResourceOverride` named `cluster`
- [NFS](post-steps/README.md#nfs): pointer; prefer a CSI driver, and the older provisioner role stays outside this repo
- [Quay 3.18](post-steps/README.md#quay): procedure; `quay-operator` on the `stable-3.18` channel
- [GitOps](post-steps/README.md#gitops): procedure; OpenShift GitOps on the `latest` channel
- [Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management](acm/README.md): pointer; use the 2.17 book, and the OpenShift 4 notes are ACM 2.4
- [OpenShift Virtualization](openshift-virt/README.md): stub; the newest install chapter found was 4.16
- [Ansible Tower (legacy)](https://github.com/tosin2013/openshift-4-deployment-notes/blob/master/post-steps/configure-ansible-tower.md): pointer to a legacy note in the OpenShift 4 repo
- [Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.3](https://github.com/tosin2013/openshift-4-deployment-notes/blob/master/post-steps/red-hat-sso-templates.md): pointer to an older template in the OpenShift 4 repo

## Using the cluster

- [Cluster checks](cluster/README.md): procedure; read-only checks once `oc` is pointed at the cluster
- [Baseline script](cluster/baseline.sh): procedure; reads versions, node OS, identity providers, operators, and feature gates
- [This lab](cluster/this-lab.md): lab record from 20 October 2026, OpenShift 5.0.0-rc.7
- [What changed from OpenShift 4](whats-new/README.md): lab record of this build, beside the 5.0 product framing
- [RHCOS 10](whats-new/rhcos-10.md): lab record of the node OS and image streams
- [Kubernetes and runtime](whats-new/kubernetes-and-runtime.md): lab record of Kubernetes 1.36 and crun
- [Operators and OLM](whats-new/operators-olm.md): lab record of catalogd beside classic OLM
- [Upgrades from 4](whats-new/upgrades-from-4.md): product path; this lab was a fresh install
- [Feature gates](whats-new/feature-gates.md): lab record of the default gate set on 5.0.0-rc.7
- [OpenShift Lightspeed](ai/lightspeed/README.md): procedure and lab record for the Lightspeed operator
- [Working cluster](ai/lightspeed/working-cluster.md): lab record of Lightspeed on cluster-84wvf
- [Agentic troubleshooting](ai/lightspeed/agentic-troubleshooting.md): lab record of alert-driven Lightspeed runs on 28 October 2026
- [Configure provider](ai/lightspeed/configure-provider.sh): procedure; writes the provider Secret from the environment and applies OLSConfig
- [Trusted CA](ai/lightspeed/providers/tls-ca.md): procedure for a private CA on the LLM endpoint
- [OpenAI provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/openai.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for OpenAI, token stays out of git
- [Azure OpenAI provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/azure-openai.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for an API key or Entra ID
- [Gemini API provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/gemini-api.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for a Gemini API key
- [Gemini Vertex provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/gemini-vertex.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for Gemini on Vertex
- [Vertex Anthropic provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/vertex-anthropic.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for Claude on Vertex
- [watsonx provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/watsonx.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for watsonx
- [RHEL AI vLLM provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/rhelai-vllm.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for a RHEL AI vLLM endpoint
- [OpenShift AI vLLM provider](ai/lightspeed/providers/rhoai-vllm.yaml): procedure; OLSConfig for an OpenShift AI vLLM endpoint
- [MCP server](ai/mcp-server/README.md): procedure and lab record for the OpenShift MCP server
- [MCP gateway](ai/mcp-server/gateway.md): lab record of Connectivity Link in front of the MCP servers
- [MCP read-only values](ai/mcp-server/values-readonly.yaml): procedure; Helm values for a read-only MCP server install
- [Sample app](ai/sample-app/README.md): procedure; a healthy httpd app and one-fault overlays for troubleshooting
- [Sample app base](ai/sample-app/base/kustomization.yaml): procedure; the healthy `troubleshoot-lab` set
- [Fault: bad image](ai/sample-app/faults/bad-image.yaml): procedure; an image tag that does not exist
- [Fault: crash loop](ai/sample-app/faults/crashloop.yaml): procedure; the container exits immediately
- [Fault: wrong selector](ai/sample-app/faults/wrong-selector.yaml): procedure; the Service selects no pods
- [Release log](releases/README.md): empty table to copy when the lab cluster moves
- [5.0.0-rc.7](releases/5.0.0-rc.7.md): lab record from 20 October 2026
- [5.0.0](releases/5.0.0.md): placeholder; the installer tarball is on the mirror, and this file is not a lab read
- [5.0.1](releases/5.0.1.md): mirror payload only; the 5.0 release notes have no 5.0.1 section
